title: A Cloud Function's state, configuration and latest build

generation.description: 1 or 2; null when the row says neither

state.description: 2nd gen `state` (ACTIVE, FAILED, DEPLOYING, DELETING, UNKNOWN) or 1st gen `status` (ACTIVE, OFFLINE, DEPLOY_IN_PROGRESS, DELETE_IN_PROGRESS, UNKNOWN), as Google reports it; null when the row carries neither (never read as ACTIVE)

stateMessages.description: 2nd gen only: the conditions behind the state

stateMessageCount.description: How many state messages the function has (stateMessages holds the first 50)

url.description: The HTTP endpoint, for an http trigger

updateTime.description: When the function last changed (a deployment, a configuration change), RFC 3339

revision.description: 2nd gen: the latest Cloud Run revision of the function's service

runService.description: 2nd gen: the name of the Cloud Run service that backs the function; null for 1st gen

memory.description: As Google states it: 2nd gen `availableMemory` (e.g. 256M, 512Mi); 1st gen availableMemoryMb written as `<n>M`

maxInstances.description: null: no cap is set (the product default applies)

maxRequestConcurrency.description: 2nd gen: requests one instance serves at once

serviceAccount.description: The service account e-mail the function runs as; null: the default one

environmentVariableCount.description: How many runtime environment variables are set; their names and values are never returned

secretReferenceCount.description: How many Secret Manager references (variables and volumes) are set; never their names or values

deployment.description: The build of the latest deployment the function names; null when it names none

build.description: Cloud Build's record of that build; null when the function names none or the build could not be read (then an error scoped `build` says why)

status.description: QUEUED, WORKING, SUCCESS, FAILURE, INTERNAL_ERROR, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, EXPIRED
